title: Knight Probability in Chessboard
goal: Find the probability that a knight remains on the board after exactly k random moves.
strategy: Each of the eight knight moves is equally likely, including moves that leave the board. Transfer one eighth of each square probability only to on-board destinations; escaped probability never returns.
